info.name: Blood Donation & Emergency Platform - Unified API Collection
info.description:
Official Single Unified Postman Collection for Blood Donation & Emergency Assistance Platform Backend.
All phases are organized into dedicated folders with automated bearer token assignment and environment variable chaining.

item.name: Phase 1 - Auth & Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
item.description: Endpoints 1-5: User registration (Donor/Recipient), Login, GCP Google OAuth Social Login, Refresh Token, Logout.

item.name: Phase 4 - Intelligent Matching, Concurrency & Donation Workflow
item.description: Endpoints 14-17: Blood compatibility lookup, Haversine proximity matching, Concurrency-safe donor acceptance transaction (PostgreSQL ACID row-locking), Donation status lifecycle (COMPLETED/CANCELLED), 90-day medical cooldown tracking, and personal donation history.

exec: pm.test('Response contains compatible blood groups and donor list', function () {

request.description: Discovers all active, eligible donors compatible with the request blood group (ABO/Rh matrix) who passed the 90-day medical cooldown, sorted by proximity in kilometers.

item.name: 14b. Find Matching Donors with Distance Filter (10 km)

request.description: Filters matching donors strictly within the specified radius in kilometers from the hospital coordinates.

exec: pm.test('Assignment created and donationId stored', function () {

request.description: Authenticated donor accepts an open emergency blood request. Uses a PostgreSQL ACID transaction with state-locking to prevent duplicate or over-fulfilled donor allocations.

item.name: 15b. Accept Blood Request (Simulated Race Condition - Conflict 409)

exec: pm.test('Status code is 409 Conflict on fulfilled request', function () {

request.description: Validates that attempts to accept an already fulfilled request or duplicate acceptance correctly rejects with 409 Conflict.

item.name: 16. Update Donation Status (Mark COMPLETED & Start Cooldown)

exec: pm.test('Donation marked COMPLETED and completedAt populated', function () {

request.description: Transitions donation assignment status to COMPLETED. In the same transaction, updates the donor's profile with lastDonationDate = now(), increments totalDonations, and starts the 90-day cooldown by setting isAvailable = false.

item.name: 17. Get My Donation History & Cooldown Statistics

exec: pm.test('Donor history contains summary statistics and donations array', function () {

request.description: Retrieves personal donation history, completed donation counts, last donation date, next eligible donation date, and medical cooldown remaining days.

item.name: Phase 5 - Real bKash Payments
item.description: Endpoints 18-20: Official bKash Tokenized Checkout API integration. Create payment, bKash callback & payment execution, transaction verification, AuditLog persistence, and payment record lookup with RBAC.

exec: pm.test('Payment initiated with bkashURL and paymentId', function () {

request.description: Initiates a bKash Tokenized Checkout payment for emergency blood request logistics/processing. Persists Payment record with status PENDING and records AuditLog entry.

exec: pm.test('Payment executed and status is COMPLETED with trxID', function () {

request.description: Simulates or handles the bKash checkout callback. Executes payment with bKash, records the transaction ID (trxID), updates status to COMPLETED, and logs an audit trail.

exec: pm.test('Payment details retrieved with payer and request info', function () {

request.description: Fetches payment details, transaction status, request metadata, and payer information. Enforces RBAC so only the payer or Admin can view.

request.description: Verifies strict access control preventing arbitrary donors from viewing other users' private financial transactions.
